<function name="IsFlagSet" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>Checks if given flag(s) is set or not.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="flag" type="number{FL}">The engine flag(s) to test, see <page>Enums/FL</page></arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Is set or not</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Checks if the player is on the ground.</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):IsFlagSet( FL_ONGROUND ))</code>
	<output>`true`</output>

</example>
